rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something at a physical or general distance.

example.english: That house is very remote from the city.
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 uk1 lei4 si5 keoi1 hou2 jyun5

rows.note: Use this when remote means that a possibility or chance is slight or unlikely.

example.english: The chance of winning the draw is remote this time.
example.traditional: 今次抽獎中獎機會好低。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 cau1 zoeng2 zung3 zoeng2 gei1 wui6 hou2 dai1

rows.note: Use this for a place that is especially remote, out of the way, or difficult to reach.

example.english: That village is very remote, deep in the mountains.
example.traditional: 嗰條村喺山入面，好偏遠。
example.jyutping: go2 tiu4 cyun1 hai2 saan1 jap6 min6 hou2 pin1 jyun5

rows.note: Use this when someone seems emotionally distant or detached from others.

example.english: They have become very remote from their colleagues.
example.traditional: 佢同同事之間變得好疏離。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tung4 tung4 si6 zi1 gaan1 bin3 dak1 hou2 so1 lei4
